data.long_meaning: Bhaarat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhaarata', meaning 'son of the earth'. In Hindu mythology, Bhaarat is the eldest brother of the Pandava brothers and is often referred to as 'India'. This name is associated with strength, courage, and wisdom. The name Bhaarat carries the meaning “Son of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhaarat usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
